terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
1. About the service

Blizka is a dating service that runs as a mini app inside Telegram. By using it you agree to these terms.

2. Who can use it

The service is available to people aged 18 and over. By signing up you confirm your age.

3. How to behave

Respect others. Insults, threats, deception, advertising and any unlawful material are forbidden. Profiles that break the rules are hidden or removed.

4. Your content

Your photos and profile text remain yours. You allow us to show them to other users of the service so that matching can work.

5. Sparks

Sparks are the in-app currency. They are not money and cannot be exchanged for money.

6. Changes

These terms may change. We will announce material changes inside the app and ask for your consent again.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
1. Who processes your data

The data controller is the owner of the Blizka service.

2. What we collect

From Telegram: your id, name, interface language and, if you allowed it, your profile photo. From you: date of birth, gender, city, dating goals and profile photos.

3. Why

To match you with people and show your profile to others. Your exact address is never shown to other users — only your city.

4. How long we keep it

For as long as you have an account. After you delete your account the data is deleted, except what the law requires us to keep longer.

5. Who we share it with

We do not sell your data. It is shared only with infrastructure providers needed to run the service, and when required by law.

6. Your rights

You can request access to your data, its correction or deletion, and withdraw your consent. Write to support inside the app.

soon.title: A game for two instead of "hi, how are you"
soon.description: The conversation often never starts: writing first is awkward and there is no obvious opening. We are building a short game that takes the first step for you.
soon.shortText: A short round for two, not a quest for the whole evening
soon.reasonText: After the game the conversation starts on its own, without a stock "hi"
soon.knowText: Questions and choices that show the person, not the profile
soon.resultText: At the end we show what matched and what came as a surprise

soon.title: We'll help restart the conversation
soon.description: Chats break off mid-sentence, and writing again feels odd. We are building prompts that give you a concrete reason to continue.
soon.reasonText: We suggest a line based on what you already talked about
soon.timingText: We notice the pause and offer help before the match cools off
soon.optionsText: Pick the one that sounds like you and send it
soon.quietText: The prompt shows up once — we won't remind you every day

soon.title: We'll find a place for the two of you
soon.description: This used to be a list of formats like "a walk" or "coffee" — the same for every pair. We are replacing it with a specific place.
soon.placeText: Not "go to a cafe", but a name, an address and how to get there
soon.photoText: You see where you are going before you invite anyone
soon.detailsText: What it costs for two, how long it takes, when to show up
soon.personalText: AI builds it from shared interests, your city and what you both prefer
